findings.evidence: GaussNorm.lean:278 defines HasGaussNorm.isRestricted_of_abs_lt; its lines 358–495 develop IsDistinguished and IsLowestDominant. None of these three new proofs uses formal preparation or DVR invariants.
findings.fix: Move these declarations to GaussNorm.lean, alongside the boundedness, dominance, and restrictedness API.
findings.issue: isRestricted_map_of_abs_lt_one, eventually_isDistinguished_and_isLowestDominant (143), and isUnit_mk_map (182) concern bounded coefficients and restricted series independently of formal preparation.

findings.evidence: Their statements and proofs use only a local ring, a seminormed target, and a ring homomorphism; UnitBall.lean already houses unit-ball, norm-one unit, and maximal-ideal comparisons.
findings.fix: Move both to a lower-level normed-ring module, such as Analysis/Normed/Ring/UnitBall.lean, and import that module here.
findings.issue: norm_map_eq_one_iff_isUnit and norm_map_lt_one_iff_mem_maximalIdeal (124) are general local-ring norm comparisons with no power-series dependency.

summary: Several reusable foundational lemmas live in the preparation comparison module, forcing unnecessary preparation and DVR dependencies on their users.
